midnight-navy.$description: Midnight Navy — Violet text accent for links, tags, and emphasized short phrases. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color

cornflower-steel.$description: Cornflower Steel — Borders, icon strokes, secondary text, tag outlines — a desaturated cousin of midnight used for structural elements that recede from primary copy

electric-blue.$description: Electric Blue — Inline links, active nav text, small accent dots — the only high-chroma blue, used sparingly to signal clickable moments

fog-white.$description: Fog White — Page canvas, subtle card fills, list backgrounds, nav backdrop — the off-white base layer that gives the navy its depth

pure-white.$description: Pure White — Card surfaces, button text on dark fills, elevated panels — the topmost surface that sits above fog

silver-lining.$description: Silver Lining — Hairline borders, inactive dividers, muted list separators — cool-tinted gray that vanishes against fog but defines against white

mist-gray.$description: Mist Gray — Soft borders on light cards, subtle background washes — a step between fog and silver for layered surfaces

smoke.$description: Smoke — Light text on dark surfaces, inverse labels, and high-contrast captions.

dusk.$description: Dusk — Secondary headings, icon fills in illustrations, mid-weight body — between smoke and midnight for visual rhythm

abyss.$description: Abyss — Deepest accent, used in illustration borders and dark-image frames — almost black but with a navy cast

voltage-yellow.$description: Voltage Yellow — Rare highlight on a single featured card or callout — used once or twice per page maximum as a visual shock

hyacinth.$description: Hyacinth — Outlined action border, rarely used — a lighter cornflower for ghost buttons that need a subtle border presence

gt-walsheim-pro.$description: Primary typeface across all UI. Geometric humanist sans with generous x-height and subtly rounded terminals. Weight 700 at 100px powers the poster-scale hero headline; weight 600 handles subheadings; weight 400 carries body, captions, and UI labels. The 100px hero with -0.125em tracking is the signature — it compresses the headline into a dense, intentional block rather than a airy web headline.

gt-america.$description: Secondary typeface for specific heading or display moments where a more compressed, neo-grotesque tone is needed. Used sparingly.
